resource_guards.limitations: Polling can overshoot; group RSS can double-count shared pages and miss peaks; workdir logical sizes exclude symlinks and stop counting after the bound is crossed.

resource_accounting.cpu_scope: direct child plus descendants accounted for by child wait
resource_accounting.rss_scope: kernel peak, not simultaneous process-tree total
resource_accounting.monitor_cpu_scope: macOS libproc is included in parent CPU; other-platform ps helper CPU is monitor_cpu_seconds

claims_limit: One exposed larger development circuit; fixed corrected adapter given equally to B1/B2/C. Prior120/240 failures retained and charged where applicable. No untouched, adaptive-selector, general completion, physical/electrical, installed/GUI or release claim. No B1/reference candidate reuse; no new spending.
timing_scope: First controller line before project imports through retained result read; prior/new audit and bootstrap allowances are separately committed. Polling guards are not OS quotas; final small emission is covered by the charged1second bootstrap/emission allowance.
